limitations.summary: No production authentication, authorization, RLS or ABAC enforcement is implemented.
Environment-referenced source values exist, but the validated defaults/TOML/env/secret-store configuration model is not implemented.

Owned serving SQLite cancels its pre-worker admission wait and interrupts active VM work after mutex acquisition. It does not pre-empt raw standard-mutex wait, already-submitted/running blocking work, busy timeout, blocking UDF/VFS/I/O, detached compiler CPU, raw/conformance work, or establish common database-native statement cancellation.

SQLite has required one-target-expression, one-hop outgoing DESCRIBE endpoint evidence with RDF-graph set union. A variable may resolve to several resources and repeated resources collapse. Multiple projected targets, unbound target variables, LIMIT/OFFSET Slice shapes, source-backed OrderBy, recursive blank-node closure and PostgreSQL/MySQL execution remain unqualified.

Only the accepted ADR-0006 non-blocking vertical exists: exactly two distinct source-affine one-triple SELECT UNION arms stream sequentially. Cross-source joins, blocking/global operators, reducers, spill, more sources/backends, consistency vectors, performance qualification and production admission remain unavailable; proposed ADR-0040 is not accepted.

The required generated train is fixed-seed SQLite SELECT only at exactly 5,000 cases per PR. The 100,000-case nightly train, other backends and query forms, NoREC/MR1, fuzzing with persisted shrinking, coverage/mutation, live services and load/soak remain unimplemented.

The finite root variable-key ORDER window is qualified by bounded compaction, independent row/payload ceilings, controlled heap/RSS, a materialized semantic oracle and the live Product Mock serve path. Expression ORDER, GROUP, solution/term DISTINCT, graph dedup and broader bounded global physical execution remain unavailable.
The parser feature recognizes LATERAL, but both compiler paths reject it and no execution profile is implemented.
The PostgreSQL/MySQL evidence can skip on provider absence and therefore cannot establish production admission.
Live result-column probes and branch emission fail closed before cursor I/O, but the sequential preflight can race later DDL and is not a coherent schema-generation lease.
No sealed W3C RDB2RDF mapping execution matrix exists for MySQL.
The MySQL source-selector branch lacks a positive open_backend selector test.

Fixed liveness/readiness endpoints and bounded three-phase shutdown are implemented. Production telemetry, layered configuration, verified TLS, automatic source-health policy, SLOs and complete cross-backend cleanup remain unimplemented.
Recursive property paths use an exact finite-pair fixed point, but total work/cancellation budgets and live PostgreSQL/MySQL qualification remain open.

Compiler-only no-primary-key path SQL maps the synthetic `rowid` sentinel to snapshot-local PostgreSQL `ctid`; a real `rowid` column still collides and live PostgreSQL path execution is not evidenced.
Mutable product-mock PostgreSQL is an optional development differential. Its table/column inventory currently rejects drift and grants no backend admission.
The complete backend contract, live matrix, security, cancellation and conformance gates in ADR-0038 R3 are incomplete.

No pinned SPARQL Protocol manifest is executed; the tested read-only HTTP subset accepts exactly one query parameter for GET/form POST or one raw query body, rejects dataset/version/extra parameters, and is not full Protocol conformance.

The serving lane shares one absolute deadline and finite ceilings for observable metadata probes, branch opens, pull attempts, semantic result items, serializer writes and ORDER textual-payload high-water growth; an independent row window bounds fixed per-row ORDER overhead. These are not a total heap ceiling. Compiler CPU, database rows scanned, recursive SQL iterations/source cost, raw/conformance callers, common source-native statement cancellation and atomic/no-prefix post-200 responses remain outside total M2 QueryBudget.

Narrow private diagnostics include same-byte static RootPie preflight, a counterfactual non-authority bubblewrap name/path inventory, and late seccomp; actual host byte consumption/runtime closure, the minimal production dependency closure, and exact-artifact release proof are not implemented.

Authored-R2RML startup constructs and semantically validates a candidate before activation, quarantines unverified constraints and type-authorized pooling, and fails closed on live result-column preflight. A committed PostgreSQL 16.9/16.15 observation now carries non-authorizing identity availability through the ordinary source and exact runtime binding; qualification, typed authority, typed synthetic row identity, a general off-path reload-candidate lifecycle, verified optimisation leases and Direct Mapping regeneration remain unimplemented.

ADR-0050 remains proposed. The implemented gate is the bounded sealed four-rule Product Mock contract for mandatory ontology plus effective authored-R2RML mapping. General SHACL, live Direct Mapping/source generation, backend-generation admission, detailed reports and production admission remain outside this slice.

Canonical semantic-builder gold and the sealed semantic-product-mock source are development authorities. The sealed relational facet covers 148 TriplesMaps/721 predicate-object maps over 112 tables/598 columns, but proves neither full live-inventory conformity, image/source provenance nor backend admission.

Immutable request leases, full-state checked publication, monotonic repeated-readiness revision fencing, shutdown fencing and startup candidate validation exist, but a general off-path reload-candidate lifecycle, automatic drift observation, complete verified backend-generation leases, public reload and automatic source health are not implemented.

SQLite serving admission caps active leased work per physical connection and each waiter is deadline/cancellation-bound. Raw pool/mutex users bypass it, round-robin is not availability-aware, and the standard mutex plus submitted/running blocking work remain non-cancellable.
Post-200 SELECT/CONSTRUCT failures terminate the body and may expose a usable prefix; they cannot become RFC 9457 responses.
Remote-source TLS verification and a production secret-store transport remain unimplemented.

cells.qualification: For active application work, Tower Service::call mints one deadline after HTTP/request-target parsing and before Axum route/method dispatch; it governs serve-layer async waiters and bounded producer checkpoints. Fixed health and query-less discovery metadata intentionally bypass query-work deadlines. Cooperative CPU/native cancellation, total QueryBudget and atomic post-200 streaming remain open.

One shared finite fail-fast gate (default 64, checked from 1 through Semaphore::MAX_PERMITS) bounds requests admitted into application work. Saturation in Service::call returns a distinct redacted 503 service-overloaded response with Retry-After: 1 before Router or request-body polling; deadline/control failures take precedence and a closed gate is an internal 500. One RequestBudget retains capacity through active streaming producers and queued/running compiler or SQLite workers after waiter timeout or drop, but releases it after active work ends even while already-produced bounded response bytes remain unread. Required tests use virtual time and explicit barriers. This is admitted application work, not total TCP connections, sockets, responses, a rate limit, fairness, native-work pre-emption, total QueryBudget, production source admission, or atomic post-200 delivery. A shed unpolled POST body can affect HTTP/1 connection reuse or reset behaviour.

The expression may identify several resources; repeated values collapse into the exact one-hop RDF-graph set union. Blank-node objects are emitted but not recursively followed. The complete lowered plan passes normal single-source admission. Only a top-level SELECT Project over UNION of exactly two one-triple BGP arms is admitted when static mapping analysis assigns each arm to one distinct active SourceId. Both sources are acquired before 200, then unchanged source-local plans stream sequentially as bag-preserving UnionAll under one snapshot lease, RequestBudget and serializer. Required evidence covers duplicate rows, UNBOUND, arm order, 0/N/N+1 budgets, ambiguous/absent/same-source/modifier pre-I/O rejection, acquisition and mid-stream failure recovery, old-generation pinning, and a real sf-cli child over two file-backed SQLite sources. Cross-source joins, blocking/global operators, reducers, spill, third sources, other backends, consistency vectors, performance qualification and production admission remain outside this accepted ADR-0006 vertical; proposed ADR-0040 remains proposed.

The exact two-source one-triple SELECT UNION vertical is implemented separately under ADR-0006. Charter-complete joins, blocking/global operators, reducers, spill, wider source/backend sets, consistency, performance and production admission remain planned; proposed ADR-0040 is not accepted.

Exactly 50 deterministic generated SQLite schema/data/R2RML fixtures times 100 SELECT queries produce the required 5,000-case per-PR train. Fixed-seed ordinal replay compares flat, tree, unoptimized and optimized compiler execution with a separately materialized spareval oracle, using bag equality unless ORDER makes sequence authoritative; projection order, duplicates, NULL/UNBOUND, IRIs and plain, language-tagged and typed literals are covered. This meets only the numeric M4 per-PR sub-gate, not nightly 100,000, other backends/forms, NoREC/MR1, fuzz/shrink, coverage/mutation, live-service or load/soak gates.

GET /livez is fixed event-loop liveness. GET /readyz projects only the existing immutable runtime readiness plus administrative shutdown state: ready is 200, not-ready is 503 with Retry-After: 1, and invalid or poisoned state is a redacted 500. Both return fixed JSON with no-store and nosniff, do not poll sources or bodies, and do not consume application-work capacity. This is not automatic source-health detection, validated reload, telemetry, TLS, SLOs or complete ADR-0011 observability.
Raw POST SELECT streaming is exercised but may skip; GET is unproven.
Raw POST transport is exercised but may skip; GET is unproven.

Required strict-subset tests accept exactly one query for GET or form POST, or one raw POST body. Raw bodies have a per-request n-byte cap; form bodies have a checked per-request 3n+16 wire cap and n-byte decoded-query cap. Optional version, dataset, duplicate and extra parameters reject instead of being ignored; unsupported media rejects without polling the application body. This is not full Protocol conformance.

The application-lifetime foundation, startup candidate validation and revision fence are implemented separately; a general off-path reload-candidate lifecycle, automatic drift/reload, complete backend-generation leases and public lifecycle integration keep the complete M5 profile planned.

One Rust state owns an immutable source-keyed runtime snapshot. Each ready request loads and pins exactly one generation and its ready-state witness before body polling through EOF, error, cancellation or drop; new requests see a complete successor or a redacted not-ready response. Private process-local binding identities reject stale plans even across content-equal replacements. Generation-only monotonic activation IDs, an opaque checked revision for every state event, exact expected-state comparison, terminal exhaustion, destructor release outside the lock and deterministic stale/slow/repeated-drift/shutdown races are required evidence. Publication is crate-private and non-authorizing: no general off-path reload-candidate builder, automatic watcher, complete verified backend-generation lifecycle, public reload, automatic source health, Direct Mapping lifecycle or source admission is claimed.
